_comment: Rule-liveness ratchet baseline (tools/raman_saab/rule_liveness.py over the golden corpus). never_fired / yogas_never are the counts that MUST NOT INCREASE. Adding a rule no golden exercises, or breaking one so it stops firing, raises the count and fails test_rule_liveness. Fixing/covering rules lowers it -> re-baseline down. Re-based after the +25 NH Track-B charts (corpus 192->217): never_fired 88->84. 2026-08-23 (dead-rule sweep, conscious bump 82->84): the sweep encoded 14 previously-dead cited rules; twelve fire on >=1 golden, but H2.C.36 and H2.C.38 (the common/movable arms of the HTJAH-I:2492-2496 wealth-magnitude triplet, bphs-doctrine-reviewer VALIDATED verbatim, four-conjunct narrow) fire on none -- position-dependent rules with no structural impossibility (the fixed-sign sibling C.37 DOES fire once). Accepting two reviewer-validated-but-corpus-unexercised rules is the deliberate trade over leaving cited doctrine dead; the count remains a floor against SILENT additions. 2026-08-23 finale (H8-H3 passes, bump 84->85): six more dead rules encoded (H8.D.2, H10.C.56, H4.C.42, H5.C.3, H6.C.1, H6.C.19); five fire on goldens, H5.C.3 (Jupiter-as-strong-5th-lord aspected by the lagna lord, HTJAH-I:5185 rasi core) fires on none -- Scorpio/Leo-lagna gate x strength x aspect is narrow but chart-dependent and satisfiable. Same deliberate trade. 2026-08-23 (audit-ticket discharge, 739->741): H2.C.42 (1st-6th parivartana + maraka touch) and H2.C.43 (non-9/10-owning malefic in Lagna + maraka touch) encoded after the verbatim corpus check of HTJAH-I:2526-2528 discharged their gate; both fire on goldens (C.42 on 1, C.43 on 29 with the node-pair guard), never_fired stays 85. Same day (741->743): H11.C.6/C.7 re-encoded on the now-public dignity.compound_relation (the naisargika reading was proven unsatisfiable 2026-08-22; the compound reading is satisfiable and both VALIDATED on review); C.6 fires 12/211, C.7 17/211, never_fired stays 85.
